# bugs #4240: Loop reversal changes the iteration order when the body casts the loop variable

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/4240/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Choose between this patch and the narrower one in the ticket, apply one, and close.
- Patch: [bugs-4240.patch](../../patches/bugs-4240.patch). Applies to r17176 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The compiler reverses `for` loops whose body uses the loop variable only through a cast, such as
`(uint8_t)i`. The loop then counts down, and the body receives the values of the variable in
descending order. `tests/bug-4240.c` contains both loops from the ticket's `bug.c` with small
changes, and it fails for mcs51 on r17158.

## Cause

`isConformingBody` in `src/SDCCast.c` decides whether `reverseLoop` may reverse a loop. Its
`switch` rejects the body when the loop variable is an operand of one of the operators that the
`switch` lists. `CAST` is not among them, and the `default` case accepts every other operator
without a test. `reverseLoop` then replaces `i` in the body by `i - 1` and makes the loop count
down.

## Fix

In the `default` case, `isConformingBody` returns false when the loop variable is the left or the
right operand of the operator.

## Decision

The patch attached to the ticket adds `case CAST` and leaves `default` unchanged. This patch puts
the test into `default`, so it applies to every operator that the `switch` does not list. `IFX`,
the node for the condition of an `if` statement, is one of them, and `tests/bug-4240.c` has a loop
with `if (i)` for it.

The cost is that the compiler reverses fewer loops. In the regression suite a few loops in the
ascon tests are not reversed for stm8 and z80 with this patch, because they use the loop variable
through a cast.

## Verification

`tests/bug-4240.c` fails for mcs51 without the patch. With the patch it passes on the host and for
every mcs51 regression target except mcs51-xstack-auto, which was not run.

## Related

The reporter also points out that `case CALL` accepts calls without arguments when the loop
variable is local. Neither patch changes that case.
